name: HEXTAR
recent: Hextar Global 公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收 RM202.4 million，净利按年下滑 14.4%。同期，大股东 Hextar Holdings 及 Dato' Ong Soon Ho 在公开市场减持部分股份，而公司于 10 月 9 日公告多项企业提案。
notable: 公司公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，营收 RM202.4 million，净利 RM13.588 million。
公司于 2026 年 10 月 9 日公告多项企业提案（MULTIPLE PROPOSALS）。
Dato' Ong Soon Ho 于 2026 年 11 月 6 日及 10 日间接减持共 13,888,800 股（约 0.354%）。
risks: 大股东 Hextar Holdings 及 Dato' Ong Soon Ho 在 2026 年 11 月减持公司股份。
公司于 2026 年 10 月 9 日公告多项企业提案，具体内容需留意后续公布。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度，营收 RM202.418 million，按年下降 12.8%，按季上升 1.7%；净利 RM13.588 million，按年下降 14.4%，按季下降 10.1%；净利率 6.7%，低于上一季度的 7.6%。

recent_en: Hextar Global reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM202.4 million and net profit down 14.4% year-on-year. Meanwhile, substantial shareholder Hextar Holdings and Dato' Ong Soon Ho disposed of some shares in the open market, and the company announced multiple proposals on 9 October.
notable_en: The company announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM202.4 million and net profit of RM13.588 million.
The company announced multiple proposals on 9 October 2026.
Dato' Ong Soon Ho indirectly disposed a total of 13,888,800 shares (about 0.354%) on 6 and 10 November 2026.
risks_en: Substantial shareholder Hextar Holdings and Dato' Ong Soon Ho disposed of company shares in November 2026.
The company announced multiple proposals on 9 October 2026; details are subject to further announcements.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM202.418 million, down 12.8% year-on-year and up 1.7% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM13.588 million, down 14.4% year-on-year and down 10.1% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 6.7%, lower than 7.6% in the previous quarter.
